messages:
sam: Ran npm audit in the console-ui CI image and flagged a HIGH prototype-pollution via dot-prop (CVE-2026-1987). Appears through set-value -> dot-prop in the webpack/enhanced-resolve chain.
raj: Can you paste the path? direct or transitive?
maria: Transitive. `console-ui > webpack > enhanced-resolve > ... > set-value > dot-prop`. Build-time only but risk is supply-chain artifact poisoning when packages are published.
sam: npm audit snippet:
```
High        Prototype Pollution
Package     dot-prop
Dependency of  enhanced-resolve
Path        console-ui > webpack > enhanced-resolve > ... > set-value > dot-prop
More info   https://npmjs.com/advisories/CVE-2026-1987
```
olivia: Options: (1) apply pnpm overrides/resolutions scoped to the ui workspace (fast), (2) bump enhanced-resolve/upstream deps (safer long term, more churn), (3) fork+patch (last resort). Pros/cons?
raj: We use pnpm v8. Overrides will work via package.json -> "overrides" but it updates the lockfile across workspaces which can be noisy.
maria: Last big lockfile sweep caused staging e2e flakiness. We have a minor release scheduled tomorrow; prefer minimal disruption.
jordan: Does this block the release? Exploitability is limited but severity is high.
sam: My recommendation: apply a focused override in the /console/ui package.json to pin dot-prop to a patched version (>=5.3.1), run CI, and backport to release branch if green. Follow up with a staged dependency upgrade epic.
olivia: Agreed. Also add a CI verification step to catch revert or regressions: fail if `npm ls dot-prop` shows vulnerable versions.
raj: Proposed override snippet to include in /console/ui package.json:
```
"overrides": {
  "dot-prop": "5.3.1"
}
```
Security advisory suggests 5.3.1+
maria: After changing overrides run `pnpm install --lockfile-only` locally, then push lockfile. CI should run with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` to avoid node_modules drift.
sam: I'll notify SRE to run an artifact registry scan on the last published packages while PR is out. @sre-team please verify nothing malicious was published.
sre-bot: queued registry artifact scan; ETA ~15-30m. No issues so far.
raj: Opening PR with override + lockfile update + reproduction steps + short changelog. Will mark as security and request reviews from @olivia @maria @sam. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/4523
olivia: Label `security`, add a short entry in the security triage log with CVE id and mitigation (override applied). Create a follow-up ticket to upgrade enhanced-resolve in a controlled manner to avoid lockfile churn.
raj: Adding a tiny script `scripts/ci/check-vulns.sh` that runs `npm ls dot-prop || true` and greps for known-bad versions; will be part of `ci:verify`.
maria: Include reproduction steps in PR description for local testing: `pnpm install && npm audit --json | jq` and how to revert the override.
sam: If CI and artifact scan are green we proceed with the minor release; otherwise block and revert.
raj: Override merged, lockfile updated. All checks green. Will backport to the release branch now. :shipit:
olivia: Good follow-ups: (a) staged upgrades epic for enhanced-resolve and webpack, (b) add automated dependency scan alert to weekly sec review, (c) roll a small integration test to ensure build outputs unchanged.
sam: Filing final note in security tracker with timelines and next steps. Closing thread.
